question: How many artists are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artist

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes (300000 milliseconds)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track WHERE milliseconds > 300000

question: List the names of all genres in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM genre ORDER BY name

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil'

question: What is the total revenue from all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM invoice

question: What are the 3 longest tracks? Return the track name and its length in milliseconds, longest first.
gold_sql: SELECT name, milliseconds FROM track ORDER BY milliseconds DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first and last names of all customers from Canada, ordered by last name and then first name.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customer WHERE country = 'Canada' ORDER BY last_name, first_name

question: How many albums does the artist 'Iron Maiden' have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album a JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = a.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Iron Maiden'

question: What is the average track length in seconds, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(milliseconds) / 1000.0, 2) FROM track

question: How many employees have the title 'Sales Support Agent'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: Which 5 genres have the most tracks? Return the genre name and the number of tracks, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY tracks DESC, g.name LIMIT 5

question: Which countries have more than 4 customers? Return the country and the number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 4

question: What are the top 5 billing countries by total invoice revenue? Return the country and the total revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY revenue DESC, billing_country LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 artists have the most albums? Return the artist name and the number of albums, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name, COUNT(*) AS albums FROM album a JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = a.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY albums DESC, ar.name LIMIT 3

question: What is the total invoice revenue for each year? Return the year and the revenue, ordered by year.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::int AS year, SUM(total) FROM invoice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many tracks are there for each media type? Return the media type name and the number of tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT m.name, COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN media_type m ON m.media_type_id = t.media_type_id GROUP BY m.name

question: For each employee who supports at least one customer, return the employee's first name, last name and the number of customers they support.
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(*) FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

question: Which artists have no albums? Return only the artist names.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name FROM artist ar LEFT JOIN album a ON a.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE a.album_id IS NULL

question: Which 5 tracks were sold the most (total quantity across all invoice lines)? Return the track name and total quantity sold, highest first, and break ties alphabetically by track name.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, SUM(il.quantity) AS sold FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id GROUP BY t.track_id, t.name ORDER BY sold DESC, t.name LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 playlists contain the most tracks? Return the playlist name and the number of tracks, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM playlist p JOIN playlist_track pt ON pt.playlist_id = p.playlist_id GROUP BY p.playlist_id, p.name ORDER BY tracks DESC, p.playlist_id LIMIT 3

question: Which albums have more than 20 tracks? Return the album title and the number of tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT al.title, COUNT(*) FROM album al JOIN track t ON t.album_id = al.album_id GROUP BY al.album_id, al.title HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

question: Which customers have spent more than the average total spending per customer? Return first name, last name and total spent.
gold_sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(i.total) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name) SELECT first_name, last_name, total_spent FROM spend WHERE total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM spend)

question: Which artist has the most tracks in the 'Jazz' genre? Return the artist name and the number of Jazz tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name, COUNT(*) AS jazz_tracks FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id JOIN album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id WHERE g.name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY jazz_tracks DESC, ar.name LIMIT 1

question: List every employee's first and last name together with their manager's first and last name. Employees without a manager should still appear, with empty manager names.
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, m.first_name, m.last_name FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee m ON m.employee_id = e.reports_to

question: Which single month had the highest total invoice revenue? Return the year, the month number and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::int, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoice_date)::int, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM invoice GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY revenue DESC, 1, 2 LIMIT 1

question: Which customers have bought tracks from at least 8 different genres? Return first name, last name and the number of distinct genres.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN invoice_line il ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) >= 8

question: How many customers made their very first purchase (earliest invoice) in the year 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, MIN(invoice_date) AS first_date FROM invoice GROUP BY customer_id) x WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_date) = 2022

question: What are the top 3 genres by sales revenue (sum of unit price times quantity on invoice lines)? Return the genre name and the revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT g.name, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS revenue FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, g.name LIMIT 3

question: For the top 3 billing countries by revenue, what percentage of total revenue (all countries) does each contribute, rounded to 2 decimals? Return the country and the percentage, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total) / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM invoice), 2) AS pct FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC, billing_country LIMIT 3

question: How many different tracks appear in more than one playlist?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT track_id FROM playlist_track GROUP BY track_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) x
